text_block_list.text:
In the morning, on my way to the Trainer's 
Room...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is the robo-training method that 
appeared in "Cyborg Warrior Robomin"—...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—.........Temporary lapse in memory 
confirmed. Diagnosing status ailment: 
'Fell Asleep.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause... appears to be... 
binge-watching the tokusatsu show reported 
earlier... night after night.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The calculated movements of that robot on 
the show... could actually serve as a 
reference for training...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To finish watching all 5 seasons... I'll 
need to keep watching... for over half a 
year...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Whew... This is for my training too, so 
I'll do my best.

Even while looking sleepy afterward... 
Mihono Bourbon continued doing the robot 
training from the tokusatsu show.
